answer: In a decentralized consensus network, AI agents can utilize a Sybil resistance mechanism known as Proof of Physical Work (PoPW). Here, agents must prove ownership of a unique physical resource, such as a saffron farm on a remote island, by providing verifiable sensory data. An attacker attempting to create multiple fake identities would need to establish multiple distinct physical locations, such as constructing cedar wood replicas of the farm, which would be prohibitively expensive and detectable, thereby securing the network against Sybil attacks.
